abort: Hey, you were hired to do a job. If you leave us out here we are going to fall into the same situation as that last executive.
arrived_at_loc: Wait at this location for our executive transport to jump into the system.
complete: The executive is safely at our headquarters. Return to Yavin station.
failed_destroy: You lost another one? I know we have alot of executives but we will eventually run out. Maybe you should come back to the station for a while.
failed_protect: You lost another one? I know we have alot of executives but we will eventually run out. Maybe you should come back to the station for a while.
found_loc: Arrival location of the executive transport has been sent to your flight computer.
goodbye_2: Good work, pilot. The company certainly could use someone like you around.
goodbye_3: I am proud of you. With you skills and my leadership we could go far.
goodbye_4: It is a good thing I was there to direct you. We could have been in real trouble out there.
goodbye_5: Someday you might amount to something.
hull_half: You are supposed to protect me. My hull is cracking...get them off of me!
panic_1: Time for you to get to work.
panic_2: Stop your loafing and get in there.
panic_3: Remember take out the lead fighter first.
panic_4: Maybe you should try using your...what are they called...oh yeah blasters on them.
panic_5: You distract them while I try to sneak away.
quest_escort_d: Escort the new executive through the system and protect him from any of the Debris Cultists who might try to stop him.
quest_location_d: The new executive will meet you in the Yavin system.
quest_rendezvous_d: Travel to the arrival location and wait for the arrival of the new executive.
reason_1: Aren't you the pilot who lost my successor? Never mind, just get me to the station.
reason_2: Aren't you the pilot who lost my successor? Never mind, just get me to the station.
reason_3: Aren't you the pilot who lost my successor? Never mind, just get me to the station.
reason_4: Aren't you the pilot who lost my successor? Never mind, just get me to the station.
reason_5: ¿No eres tú el piloto que perdió a mi sucesor? No importa, llévame a la estación.
shields_depleted: Pues se nos fueron los escudos. Necesito que los quites de nosotros inmediatamente.
taunt_1: Les mostraremos a los hombres de la compañía lo que es convertirse en uno con los escombros.
taunt_2: Has tomado tu último trozo de tierra sagrada.
taunt_4: No os asustéis, hermanos. ¡No tienen fe!
taunt_5: ¡El poder de la gran bola de fuego está de mi lado!
thanks_1: Así que sí tienes algo de talento. ¡Bien!
thanks_2: Hubieras hecho mejor si hubieras seguido mis instrucciones.
thanks_3: La próxima vez, intenta destruirlos más rápido.
thanks_4: Tengo una fecha límite que cumplir. Sigamos moviéndonos.
title: Sistema Yavin: Acompaña a la ejecutiva de Yavin Mining Co.
title_d: Aunque perdiste a la última ejecutiva de la compañía, tenían un plan de respaldo. Otra ejecutiva espera entrar al sistema pero necesita una escolta a través del mismo.
